chunks: Will surely have Paradise for abode.

key_terms.الْجَنَّةَ: Paradise, the eternal abode of bliss
key_terms.الْمَأْوَىٰ: The dwelling place, home, or refuge

ai.seo_question: What is the ultimate destination for the believers according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *al-Ma'wa* (the ultimate abode) as not merely a physical location but a state of spiritual fulfillment and proximity to the Divine. It serves as a theological anchor for believers, contrasting the transient nature of worldly life with the eternal stability of Paradise, a theme often linked to the purity of the Ahl al-Bayt as the true inheritors of this divine grace.
